column1: # Golden review-grid flags: real model output that must not pass silently.
#   problem  — demonstrably wrong; the operator must fix it
#   check    — nothing can vouch for it; the operator must read it
#   clean    — must raise nothing at all
# MEASURED. Every `problem` and `check` row is real output from
# opus-mt-en-ml over a realistic 18-string price list, recorded in NEXT.md 1.6
# on 2026-08-26. At the time, the ONLY detector that fired was a word-count
# heuristic, on 4 rows — every row below came back `needs_attention: false`.
# Why these are the hard cases: a word-count heuristic cannot fire on a
# one-word cell, and one-word cells are exactly the product names. The `clean`
# rows exist to stop the fix from flagging everything, which would be the same
